inviteAccepted.title: Invite accepted
inviteAccepted.description: When someone you invited (or anyone, for owners) creates their account.

login.title: Welcome home
login.description: Log in to manage your household.
login.invalid: That email and password don't match.
login.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask an owner of your household to enable it.

setup.title: Set up WickedHome
setup.description: Create your household and the first account. You can add the other habitants afterwards.
setup.householdNameHint: For example "The Coppens family" or "Wicked Home".
setup.alreadyDone: WickedHome is already set up. Log in instead.

account.localeFailed: Your language couldn't be saved. Try again.

roles.childHint: Can use the app, but can't change settings or accounts.

share.copyFailed: The link couldn't be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
share.shareFailed: Sharing didn't work. Copy the link instead.
share.qrLabel: QR code of the link for {{name}}

invite.title: Join {{household}} on WickedHome
invite.text: Hi {{name}}, here's your link to join {{household}} on WickedHome:
invite.scanHint: {{name}} can scan this with their phone camera, or you send the link.

reset.title: New password for WickedHome
reset.text: Hi {{name}}, use this link to set a new WickedHome password:
reset.scanHint: {{name}} can scan this with their phone camera, or you send the link.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: They get a link to create their own login. Only you see the link, once.
invite.readyDescription: Copy or share it now: for safety it isn't shown again. You can always make a new one.

errors.hasAccount: This person already has an account.
errors.forbidden: You can't invite someone with this role.

section.title: Accounts
section.description: Who can log in, and invites for the others.

accounts.errorDescription: The rest of the settings still work.
accounts.lastOwnerHint: You're the only owner, so you can't step down or be removed.
accounts.resetReadyDescription: Give it to them now: it isn't shown again. With it they set a new password, and all their devices are signed out.

confirm.ownerDescription: Owners can do everything, including changing or removing other owners.
confirm.demoteSelfDescription: You become {{role}}. Only an owner can make you owner again.
confirm.disableDescription: They are signed out on every device and can't log in until the account is enabled again.
confirm.signOutDescription: Every device they're logged in on is signed out. They can log in again with their password.
confirm.removeDescription: The login is deleted. {{name}} stays a habitant and keeps their history; you can invite them again later.
confirm.revokeDescription: The link stops working right away.

errors.lastOwner: The household needs at least one owner.
errors.self: You can't do that with your own account.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that with this account.
errors.gone: This account or invite no longer exists.

section.title: My account
section.description: Your email, password, language and devices.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address you log in with. Confirm the change with your password.

password.title: Password
password.description: Your other devices are signed out after the change; this one stays logged in.
password.saved: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.

myAccount.languageDescription: The language of WickedHome on all your devices.

devices.title: Devices
devices.confirmDescription_one: {{count}} other device is signed out. You stay logged in here.
devices.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} other devices are signed out. You stay logged in here.

link.askSomeone: Ask an adult of your household for a new link.
link.emailHint: You log in with this address.

invite.title: Join {{household}}
invite.description: {{inviter}} invited you as {{name}} ({{role}}). Choose how you log in.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: For {{name}} ({{email}}). Your devices are signed out; this one is logged in afterwards.

expired.description: Links only work for a limited time.

used.resetTitle: This reset link was already used
used.description: Every link works once. If it was you, just log in.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.description: Check that you opened the whole link, or ask for a new one.

rateLimited.title: Too many tries
rateLimited.description: Wait a few minutes, then open the link again.

unavailable.title: WickedHome can't be reached
unavailable.description: Check your connection and try again.

loggedIn.title: You're logged in as {{name}}
loggedIn.inviteDescription: This invite is for {{name}}. Log out first if you want to create that account on this device.
loggedIn.resetDescription: This link sets a new password for {{name}}. Log out first to use it on this device.

errors.loggedIn: Someone is logged in on this device. Log out first.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account.

cleanup.title: Clean up logins
cleanup.description: Deletes expired sessions and expired invite and password-reset links.
